SEC 1: raw P-256 public key 64 bytes (x||y), raw signature 64 bytes (r||s). Note: postfiatd uses secp256k1 ECDSA with DER serialization (src/libxrpl/protocol/SecretKey.cpp:248-252, 72-byte buffer), not P-256; P-256 is measured here only as the OpenSSL-speed baseline for a 256-bit ECDSA. DER length varies (70-72 bytes); the 64-byte figure is the raw r||s form.

liboqs.name_mapping: liboqs 0.14.0 does not register the FIPS 205 names (SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s); the same parameter sets are registered under their SPHINCS+ names (SPHINCS+-SHA2-128s-simple). The FIPS 205 parameter sets and the SPHINCS+ simple parameter sets are identical; see FIPS 205 section 10 and the liboqs header src/sig/sphincs/sig_sphincs.h.

note: Parameter sizes in bytes. Post-quantum sizes are FIPS 204 Table 2 (ML-DSA) and FIPS 205 Table 2 (SLH-DSA), cross-checked against the liboqs 0.14.0 headers (src/sig/ml_dsa/sig_ml_dsa.h and src/sig/sphincs/sig_sphincs.h) and against the measured lengths printed by harness/bench_sig.c — all three agree byte for byte. Classical sizes are the standard values (RFC 8032 section 5.1.5 for Ed25519; SEC 1 for P-256) and the Ed25519 signature length (64) is additionally measured by harness/hybrid_bench.c via OpenSSL EVP. NIST security categories are from FIPS 204 Table 1 and FIPS 205 Table 2.
